instruction: Candid documentary photograph, close-up shot with a shallow depth of field in an indoor judo dojo. On the left, the young woman in the blue judo gi (R1) faces right, gripping the lapel of the young man in the white judo gi (R2). On the right, the young man (R2) faces left, gripping her shoulder and collar. Both maintain a focused, serious expression during the close-up grapple. The scene is lit by soft natural light.
